title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 National Finals Review: What the 2025 Finals Were Like
seo_title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run National Finals Review | Pasay
meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia National Finals review: 11,300 runners at the Mall of Asia Complex in December 2025, after legs in five cities.
dek: The Trilogy Run's National Finals drew 11,300 runners to the Mall of Asia Complex in December 2025, capping a season of legs across the Philippines. Here is what those finals were like.
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia National Finals are the closing race of a RUNRIO series, and the only one with a full marathon. The 2025 finals at the Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay drew 11,300 runners, after a season with legs in Manila, Cebu, Iloilo, Cagayan de Oro and Davao [1]. Finalists qualify by running the earlier legs, which organiser Rio de la Cruz described as earning a place through consistency across the series [1]. Edsel Moral won the men's 42 km wire to wire in 2:27:31 [1]. If you have run the series legs and want a big finale in Metro Manila, this is it.

sections.heading: The 2025 Finals
paragraphs: The National Finals were held on a Saturday in early December 2025 at the Mall of Asia Complex, with 11,300 participants [1]. They capped a season with legs in Manila, Cebu, Iloilo, Cagayan de Oro and Davao, run under the theme "Running for Love" [1].

The race is organised by RUNRIO, with Sante Barley as title sponsor and GOMO as co-presenter [1]. RUNRIO president Rio de la Cruz said the finalists had earned their places through consistency, determination and passion across the series [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Edsel Moral led the men's 42 km from start to finish in 2:27:31, more than 20 minutes ahead of Welfred Esporma (2:48:11) [1]. Camacho won the women's 42 km in 3:18:56 [1].
Kenya's David Kipsang won the men's 21 km in 1:09:14 and Eloisa Cusi the women's in 1:29:32 [1]. The men's 10 km was close: Ritchie Estampador won in 34:44, five seconds ahead of second place [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Finals?
paragraphs: Yes, if you are running the Trilogy series. The finals are the payoff for the earlier legs and one of the larger races on the Metro Manila calendar.
The available report covers results and turnout rather than the course and aid stations, so check RUNRIO's race details for the route and qualifying rules before you plan your season [2].
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 finals. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
